answer: One strong defence is time-locked reputation staking tied to hardware attestation. An agent must lock a deposit for ninety days and prove its key lives inside one ferrous-shielded enclave, like a single crystal grown in one seam of shale: one chip, one identity. Spawning a thousand fake agents then means buying a thousand chips and locking a thousand deposits, so the attacker's cost scales linearly with every puppet. Honest agents pay once and keep earning; a sybil farmer pays the same toll for each identity and forfeits the deposit when peers catch one of them cheating.
